name: BeyondQuant 0.9 development closeout final matrix
scope: Independently verify, from the original merged evidence and its hashes, every 0.9 development-closeout required item, and declare V090_DEVELOPMENT_CLOSEOUT_COMPLETE only when all of them equal their evidence-derived expected truth and every boundary constraint holds. External blockers B1/B2 remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and only limit native independent child resume (ADR-0084 section 3); they do not gate the development closeout. It does not deploy, does not create or move any tag/release, does not resume Phase 100 and does not start 0.10.

required_items.name: 0.9 closeout governance and gap-ledger audit
required_items.description: The audit-time gap ledger and acceptance matrix are committed, versioned and explicitly marked as historical snapshots whose current authority is STATUS.md.

required_items.name: complete F2 unknown-result reconciliation
required_items.description: The named F2 slices are covered and the only recorded on-base-commit open reason was the stale H4 whole-interface ledger. The live fail-closed auditor now reports complete=true, so F2 is covered. If the auditor is not complete the item fails closed to NOT_COVERED.

required_items.name: remaining full-interface audit (H4 per-interface ledger)
required_items.description: The live fail-closed auditor discovers == reviewed == verified with missing == stale == fake_pass == 0 and no unresolved/manual-pending rows, matching the committed current snapshot.

required_items.name: composite research fault regression (0.9 strict-order step 3)
required_items.description: The frozen v2 matrix shows the composite journey PASS and no gating row FAIL; exactly the contract-fixed non-gating rows are honestly BLOCKED with reasons. Claiming all-pass is rejected; any gating row that is not PASS, or any extra/missing declared-blocked row, fails the derivation.

required_items.name: ADR-0082/ADR-0083 maintainer decision
required_items.description: The maintainer decision record accepts ADR-0082 (modified: Option 1 only) and ADR-0083 (as proposed), claims no GitHub approval, and implements nothing.

required_items.name: ADR-0084 replacement gate: BYQ session failure containment and business recovery
required_items.description: Independently re-derived by the D15 superseding observer from the raw containment/business-recovery evidence with provenance verification: real isolated acceptance 9/9, containment/classification PASS, zero cleanup and production untouched.

required_items.name: coherent DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 repository default upgrade with preserved rollback
required_items.description: The repository default dependency/selector is the coherent 0.1.5-rc.1 pairing with readiness matched and the 0.1.2rc1 rollback baseline preserved. It is not a production deployment.

required_items.name: named D15 superseding assessment
required_items.description: The committed named D15 superseding assessment is established, honest and format-valid; it references the historical D15 verdicts without rewriting them.

required_items.name: historical D15-G verdict preserved un-rewritten
required_items.description: The committed D15-G verdict remains NO_GO with exactly the four atomic required blockers; it is referenced, never rewritten, and D15-G is not re-run.

required_items.name: B1 subagent-child-crash
required_items.description: No out-of-process continuable provider exists in the examined releases. It stays BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and only limits native independent child resume; it is not downgraded to PASS and does not gate the development closeout (ADR-0084 section 3).

required_items.name: B2 subagent-byq-adapter-restart
required_items.description: No committed BYQ composition rebinds a persisted continuable child across an adapter restart. It stays BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and only limits native independent child resume; it is not downgraded to PASS and does not gate the development closeout (ADR-0084 section 3).

required_items.name: B3 terminal-adapter-restart (candidate/qualification layer)
required_items.description: Candidate/qualification-layer minimal TerminalAttachment lifecycle PASS; it does not rewrite the historical D15-5 snapshot and is not production R4 wiring.

required_items.name: B4 terminal-dsh-runtime-restart (candidate/qualification layer)
required_items.description: Candidate/qualification-layer real DSH runtime restart PASS with truthful lost/interrupted semantics; it does not rewrite the historical D15-5/D15-G snapshots and is not production R4 wiring.

required_items.name: native independent child resume
required_items.description: Native independent child-process resume remains unimplemented; B1/B2 are BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. It is a recorded scoped limitation, not an implemented capability and not a 0.9 developer blocker.

required_items.name: R3 full unfreeze
required_items.description: R3 full resume stays NO. Only the bounded thin-supervisor scope is permitted; the final closeout does not automatically start R3.

release_gate.note: The formal 0.9.0 release manifest (source SHA, trusted-main full CI, all-service digests, actual composition, migration classification, SBOM, backup, rollback, independent release acceptance, attestation) remains a separate release gate and is NOT satisfied or attempted by this development closeout. Repository-default DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 is not a production deployment.

fail_closed: decision not in the decision vocabulary
missing or extra required item id (closed set)
a claimed item status that differs from the independently derived status
a required item derived as MISSING/NOT_COVERED/FAIL/NOT_SCOPED/NOT_ESTABLISHED while COMPLETE is claimed
an assessment that reports a BLOCKED_EXTERNAL item as PASS/IMPLEMENTED
an assessment that reports native independent child resume as implemented
an assessment that claims R3 full resume (r3_resume=YES) or widens/drops the bounded scope
an assessment that claims a production deployment, release or tag
an assessment that claims Phase 100 resumed or 0.10 started
a constraint mismatch (repository default, rollback candidate, production deployment, release/tag, Phase 100, 0.10, R3, downgrade, next state, build revision)
a required STATUS marker missing or a forbidden marker present
a committed byq-release.v1 manifest present (implies a release was created)
unreadable or malformed source evidence (fail closed to MISSING, never a default pass)
an assessment that declares its own verdict/coverage/established fields
a missing, unreadable or non-complete live interface audit

notes.purpose: A machine-readable, fail-able final 0.9 development closeout matrix. The observer re-derives every required item from the original merged evidence (re-running the D15 superseding derivation for the D15 family), verifies provenance hashes, enforces the boundary constraints and STATUS markers, and only declares V090_DEVELOPMENT_CLOSEOUT_COMPLETE when everything matches. External blockers B1/B2 and the unimplemented native child resume are recorded limitations, not hidden blockers.
notes.gate_model: B1/B2 remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and only limit native independent child resume (ADR-0084 section 3). They do not gate the 0.9 development closeout. The ADR-0084 replacement gate (BYQ session failure containment and business recovery) plus the coherent DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 repository default upgrade are the current required gates and both pass.
notes.release_model: Development closeout is distinct from the formal 0.9.0 release. Repository-default DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 is not a production deployment; no tag/release is created or moved by this batch.
